name: core-engine
description: Core Engine - Core Engine: plataforma de comercio electronico distribuido (microservicios NestJS + Supabase + Docker)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @core/api-gateway && npm run build -w @core/identity-service && npm run build -w @core/catalog-service && npm run build -w @core/stores-service && npm run build -w @core/orders-service && npm run build -w @core/logistics-service && npm run build -w @core/commissions-service && npm run build -w @core/finance-service && npm run build -w @core/field-service && npm run build -w @core/market-intelligence-service && npm run build -w @core/storage-service
scripts.test: npm run test -w @core/shared -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/api-gateway -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/orders-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/commissions-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/finance-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/market-intelligence-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/catalog-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/identity-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/stores-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/logistics-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/field-service -- --coverage && npm run test -w @core/storage-service -- --coverage
scripts.k6:smoke: docker run --rm --network host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD/tests/k6:/scripts" -e BASE_URL -e K6_EMPRESA_ID -e K6_STORE_SLUG -e K6_BUYER_EMAIL -e K6_BUYER_PASSWORD -e K6_READY -e K6_INTERNAL_KEY -e K6_EDGE_BASIC_AUTH -e K6_SUMMARY=/scripts/k6-summary.json grafana/k6:latest run --quiet /scripts/smoke.js
scripts.k6:load: docker run --rm --network host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD/tests/k6:/scripts" -e BASE_URL -e K6_EMPRESA_ID -e K6_STORE_SLUG -e K6_BUYER_EMAIL -e K6_BUYER_PASSWORD -e K6_READY -e K6_INTERNAL_KEY -e K6_EDGE_BASIC_AUTH -e K6_LOAD_RATE -e K6_LOAD_DURATION -e K6_LOAD_PRE_VUS -e K6_LOAD_MAX_VUS -e K6_SUMMARY=/scripts/k6-summary.json grafana/k6:latest run --quiet /scripts/load.js
scripts.k6:breakpoint: docker run --rm --network host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD/tests/k6:/scripts" -e BASE_URL -e K6_EMPRESA_ID -e K6_STORE_SLUG -e K6_BUYER_EMAIL -e K6_BUYER_PASSWORD -e K6_READY -e K6_INTERNAL_KEY -e K6_EDGE_BASIC_AUTH -e K6_BREAK_START_RATE -e K6_BREAK_RATE_1 -e K6_BREAK_RATE_2 -e K6_BREAK_RATE_3 -e K6_BREAK_RATE_4 -e K6_BREAK_RATE_5 -e K6_BREAK_STAGE_DURATION -e K6_BREAK_PRE_VUS -e K6_BREAK_MAX_VUS -e K6_SUMMARY=/scripts/k6-summary.json grafana/k6:latest run --quiet /scripts/breakpoint.js
scripts.mutation:critical: npm run mutation -w @core/identity-service && npm run mutation -w @core/orders-service && npm run mutation -w @core/commissions-service && npm run mutation -w @core/finance-service
scripts.swagger:export: npm run build && npm run swagger:export --workspaces --if-present && node scripts/cli.mjs swagger && npm run build -w @core/api-gateway
scripts.k6:write: docker run --rm --network host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD/tests/k6:/scripts" -e BASE_URL -e K6_STORE_SLUG -e K6_EDGE_BASIC_AUTH -e K6_INTERNAL_KEY -e K6_WRITE_RATE -e K6_WRITE_DURATION -e K6_WRITE_PRE_VUS -e K6_WRITE_MAX_VUS -e K6_WRITE_BUYERS -e K6_WRITE_PASSWORD -e K6_SUMMARY=/scripts/k6-summary.json grafana/k6:latest run --quiet /scripts/write.js
scripts.k6:soak: docker run --rm --network host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD/tests/k6:/scripts" -e BASE_URL -e K6_EMPRESA_ID -e K6_STORE_SLUG -e K6_BUYER_EMAIL -e K6_BUYER_PASSWORD -e K6_EDGE_BASIC_AUTH -e K6_INTERNAL_KEY -e K6_READY -e K6_SOAK_RATE -e K6_SOAK_DURATION -e K6_SOAK_WRITE_PCT -e K6_SOAK_WRITE_BUYERS -e K6_SOAK_WRITE_PASSWORD -e K6_WRITE_PASSWORD -e K6_SOAK_READ_VUS -e K6_SOAK_MAX_VUS -e K6_SOAK_WRITE_VUS -e K6_SOAK_WRITE_MAX_VUS -e K6_SUMMARY=/scripts/k6-summary.json grafana/k6:latest run --quiet /scripts/soak.js
